scope.description: Separate CLI/unit snapshot of 19 precisely mapped capabilities, not the full EnergyManager2 contract. Actual offline CLI/unit execution uses disposable independently authored input; the Config application identity is a recovered binding TARGET, not an executed GUI. Per-capability condition scopes and omissions are preserved in binding.reason. Original GUI requirements remain missing; no old GUI observations are imported. Excluded full-scope capabilities: priority-button-state, gui-baseline-migration, storage-priority-runtime, storage-zero-runtime-sentinel, daily-cycle-runtime, structural-load-crud, invalid-reference-validation, nonfinite-overflow-validation, dirty-cancel-rollback. Icon support is preservation only; deadlines support Sunset/Dusk edits and native-only 24:00 inspection; customization markers lack fresh GUI transitions. Runtime dependencies, numeric GUI filtering/overflow equivalence, structural CRUD, reference validation, migration and dirty-cancel feedback are not complete. Fresh combined GUI/CLI/unit proof is required before any parity claim.

binding.reason: O is Offset grid power parameter, not output; kW, default 0, signed values. Positive permits import/storage draw; negative reserves export/storage charge. Invariant decimal XML; decimal-comma GUI verified -1.25 and 2.75. CLI snapshot condition scope: Signed O values -1.25/2.75 and explicit zero; parameter direction; positive/negative nonzero decimal underflow; invalid NaN/scientific input; dry-run. CLI subset omissions: scientific/GUI numeric input equivalence; storage/import/export runtime behavior. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Percent; default 0, catalog 0..100 inclusive; GUI 0/100 verified. Values above zero document storage-charge priority, but runtime dependency execution is separately unknown. CLI snapshot condition scope: MinSoc zero/100 endpoints, omitted versus explicit-zero inspection, rejection of -1/101 and positive/negative nonzero decimal underflow. CLI subset omissions: GUI prefix filtering; Soc/Spwr storage-priority runtime. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Maximum storage charging power, kW; default/minimum 0, no catalog upper bound. 5.5 and 0 saved. Zero runtime sentinel meaning is separately unknown. CLI snapshot condition scope: MaxSpwr5.5/0 storage; negative and positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection without zero-runtime interpretation. CLI subset omissions: MaxSpwr=0 runtime semantics; GUI negative input filtering. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Twelve direct records including unused slots; XML order is priority 1..12. Reorder whole records without renumbering OIdx or changing Id/references. Structural add/delete remains unknown. CLI snapshot condition scope: Twelve direct existing slots including canonical native 8-4-4-16 IDs; full-record move to2; sparse shape rejection; dry-run. CLI subset omissions: structural add/delete acceptance; sparse/>12-row native acceptance. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

CLI subset omissions: native malformed/dangling identity acceptance. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

CLI subset omissions: native missing/duplicate output-index acceptance. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Integer seconds, absent 0; GUI minutes convert via QVariant::toInt then x60. 1,5 rounds to 2 =>120; -1 min accepted/saved -60. No invented nonnegative validator; overflow domain unverified. CLI snapshot condition scope: Integer2 and -1 minutes to120/-60 seconds; zero omission; checked overflow; dry-run. CLI subset omissions: fractional GUI rounding; native overflow/scientific-input semantics; runtime scheduling. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

CLI subset omissions: Sunrise/Dawn/hourly GUI-save validation; invalid native selector acceptance; deadline execution. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

CLI snapshot condition scope: Zero SwPwr substitution, rated-zero switch copy, above-rated values, and positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection before substitution. CLI subset omissions: runtime switching behavior; GUI filtering. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Double kW, default/minimum0. Zero accepted and omitted in XML; existing U=true remains; row pink. Native rated setter substitutes its value into SwPwr if SwPwr was zero. CLI snapshot condition scope: Rated4 zero-switch copy, explicit rated0 omission with U=true, and positive/negative nonzero-underflow rejection. CLI subset omissions: native all-zero runtime behavior; GUI filtering. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.

Observed unused rows pink and connected zero-rated row pink. Native pink condition is U==0 OR MaxPwr<=0; GUI label explicitly identifies unconnected outputs as unused. CLI snapshot condition scope: Storage-derived unused condition !U || MaxPwr<=0 on unused/default and connected rated-zero slots. CLI subset omissions: GUI rendering equivalence; connection-state mutation. Original GUI recovery is separate and is not imported as this run's evidence.
